description:
Modify the Jitsi Meet configuration to add custom Google STUN servers to the Peer-to-Peer (P2P) settings. 

Goal: Edit the file `/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/config.js`. Locate the `p2p` configuration block and add the following two servers to the `stunServers` list:
- `stun:stun.l.google.com:19302`
- `stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302`

Ensure P2P remains enabled. After editing, restart the Jitsi Meet web container (using docker or docker-compose in `/home/ga/jitsi`) to apply changes. Finally, verify the changes by loading `http://localhost:8080/config.js` in Firefox and taking a screenshot of the browser showing the new configuration.
